2607.26967.title: Generation or Judgement? A Paradigm Perspective on LLM-Based Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversation
2607.26967.paper_summary: Emotion-cause pair extraction in conversation (ECPEC) identifies utterance pairs in which one utterance causes an emotion expressed in another. Recent LLM-based approaches formulate ECPEC at markedly different granularities, ranging from generating complete pair sets to judging individual candidate pairs. In this paper, we make the surprising observation that task formulation substantially affects performance, where pair-level judgement outperforms dialogue-level generation in all 18 controlled comparisons. We investigate the sources of this paradigm gap and find that many relations omitted by dialogue-level generation remain recognizable under explicit pair queries, under which the model recognizes 92.7%-98.1% of emotion-cause relations. This suggests that LLMs can recognize emotion-cause relations but struggle to discover and return complete pair sets. Pair-level judgement alleviates this burden, although its candidate rankings are more reliable than the binary decisions produced by a shared threshold. Based on this diagnosis, we introduce an auxiliary retriever that selectively re-examines ambiguous boundary cases, yielding consistent F1 improvements of 0.50-1.46 points across three datasets while maintaining an inference time of only 1.49x that of the baseline paradigm. These findings show that task decomposition and candidate scope are critical to effectively utilizing LLMs for ECPEC.
2607.26967.paper_summary_zh: 情感-原因配對提取（ECPEC）在對話中識別一對話語，其中一個話語引起另一個話語中表達的情感。最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的方法在明顯不同的粒度上制定ECPEC，範圍從生成完整的配對集到評估個別候選配對。在本文中，我們驚訝地觀察到，任務的制定對性能有顯著影響，其中配對級別的判斷在所有18個控制比較中均優於對話級別的生成。我們調查了這一範式差距的來源，發現許多被對話級別生成省略的關係在明確的配對查詢下仍然可識別，在這種情況下，模型識別了92.7%-98.1%的情感-原因關係。這表明LLM可以識別情感-原因關係，但在發現和返回完整的配對集方面存在困難。配對級別的判斷減輕了這一負擔，儘管其候選排名比共享閾值產生的二元決策更可靠。基於這一診斷，我們引入了一個輔助檢索器，選擇性地重新檢查模糊的邊界案例，在三個數據集上產生了0.50-1.46點的一致F1改進，同時保持的推理時間僅為基線範式的1.49倍。這些發現表明，任務分解和候選範圍對有效利用LLM進行ECPEC至關重要。
